parts.text:
Done. Set up a Rust library at `/work` using the `bitflags` crate.

- `Cargo.toml`: added `bitflags = "2.13.2"` (edition 2024).
- `src/lib.rs:5`: defines `Permissions: u8` via `bitflags!` with `READ`, `WRITE`, `EXECUTE`, `DELETE`, plus a `read_write()` helper and `grants()` checker.
- Supports combining (`|`), intersecting (`&`), and checking (`contains`) out of the box. All 5 tests pass and clippy is clean.
